environment.label: E-crprop
environment.build_notes: Built per USINE's README/doc/install.rst (out-of-source cmake in <TOOL_HOME>/build, make -j4; products go to <TOOL_HOME>/bin and <TOOL_HOME>/lib) with no source change. Three host adaptations, none in the source tree: (1) CMakeLists.txt requires cmake 2.8, so -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 for cmake 4.3.2; (2) FindROOT.cmake parses only the old 'X.YY/ZZ' version form, so ROOTSYS points to a root-config shim (<BUILD_ROOT>/usine-shim/bin/root-config, sha256 6b94a4dea679162554582ed46a6b21ec4f7557d91fcee7a07ea392cbc2b1a0af) that prints 6.38/04 for --version and passes every other option to the Homebrew root-config; (3) -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=17 adds -std=gnu++17 after USINE's -std=c++14 (ROOT 6.38 needs C++17). The host shell sets ROOT_INCLUDE_PATH to the Xcode 26.4 SDK libc++ directory; with it rootcling (dictionary step) mixes those headers with the CommandLineTools MacOSX26.sdk (26.2) compiled into libCling and segfaults (make-1.log, exit 139), so the build runs with ROOT_INCLUDE_PATH unset. At run time keep the host ROOT_INCLUDE_PATH: without it the ROOT interpreter started by TApplication cannot load the std module ('__configuration/experimental.h' not found) and prints 13 'cling::runtime::gCling unresolved' warnings; the smoke outputs are identical either way. -O0 (USINE's default flags). usine main() returns 1 on every path, so exit status 1 is normal. dirty=true: untracked USINE test outputs (usine.tests/*.fail); build/, bin/, lib/, src/usine_Dict.* are git-ignored by USINE.

seeds.note: not applicable: the -l local-flux run of init.TEST.par is deterministic (two runs give identical outputs)

tolerances.note: smoke run: existence and run-to-run identity of the outputs only; installation test: usine -tUSINE (17 min 51 s, -O0 build): 42 of 46 reference tests pass; 4 differ from usine.tests/*.ref without changing a result: class_TUDatime (local time zone UTC+8 in printed dates), usine_i_options (label text of two plot axes and last-digit differences), usine_e_options (last-digit and roundoff differences: values below 1e-12 differ by at most 6.5e-14, and one tail point at 1.2e-10, about 1e-9 of the peak, by 2 percent), propag_minimisation (same chi2_min and best fit; covariance entries differ by at most 1.5e-5 relative; the reference run also stops at Minuit2's call limit). doc/install.rst states that last digits differ on macOS
